title: Sales Representative: role permissions match the expected set
custom_preconds: 1. A user is assigned the Sales Representative role.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Sales Representative role's Permission Summary (eye icon on the Roles list).
  2. Check the add/edit/delete areas, the Page Access toggles, the Work orders sub-settings, the View mode and the Cross-Cutting Toggles.
  3. Optionally log in as the user and spot-check a few of the role's typical tasks.
custom_expected: The Sales Representative permissions match the expected set: all add/edit/delete areas off; Reports on; See Financial Data on; View and Manage AP/AR Data on; View History Logs off; all Work orders sub-settings off; View mode Full View. Only the Reports area is reachable; with Reports on the 6 AP/AR aging reports open.
viu_status: Roles-API-Verified (permission set matches the live role); workflow spot-checks Blocked-UI
evidence: Sales Representative permission set confirmed live via GET /api/roles/{id} (roles-matrix-2026-07-13).
